create_layer_norm: create a LayerNorm module to normalize inputs along specified axes with trainable scale and offset
create_instance_norm: create an InstanceNorm module to normalize inputs along spatial dimensions for image data
build_conditional_normalization: build conditional normalization by passing external scale and offset tensors at call time
test_layer_norm_channels_last: test LayerNorm with channels_last data format normalizing over channel axis
review_instance_norm_spatial: review InstanceNorm normalizing over spatial dimensions excluding batch and channel axes
